_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Incoming Inspection Summary Report
summary: The Incoming Inspection Summary Report summarizes the results of incoming inspection, including contractor source inspection, of all parts associated with an equipment type to evaluate the quality of material received from outside sources.
use_relationship:
The Incoming Inspection Summary Report is a summary of the results of an incoming inspection including contractor source inspection of all parts associated with an equipment type. Each summary report is limited to an equipment type such as space, ground, etc.
The report is used to evaluate the quality of material being received from outside sources.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task equipment for this data included in the contract.
This report is required when equipment parts are subject to incoming inspections.
This DID supercedes DI-QCIC-80376
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format:
preparation_instructions.content: The Incoming Inspection Summary Report shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content:
preparation_instructions.content: The summary report shall contain the following information:

children.title: A title page which shall contain the following:
Report title.
Equipment nomenclature.
Report date.
Security classification of the report.
Contract number.
Name(s) and official title(s) of the preparer(s) of the report.
Signature of an authorized company representative.
Brief introduction that includes the scope and purpose of the report.
Brief description of the incoming test procedures and objectives.
A summary of all parts receiving an incoming inspection in tabular form, whenever possible, shall include the following information:
Part type, part number, vendor, and vendor part number.
Nonconforming Material Report (NCMR) Number (if applicable).
Lot size (by lot date code).
Quantity inspected - by lot date code (including sampling level used, if applicable).
Quantity rejected - by lot date code.
Rejection rate.
Disposition (including corrective action implemented).
Defect description.
Histograms which reflect the recorded variables in 3.4 above.
